what: One review round of the plan v1.1 package (texts and tools) by two separate read-only reviewer sub-agents, before anything ran under v1.1. Each found one MAJOR, each fix was applied and re-checked, both ended ACCEPT.

text_review.round_1: REJECT (hold) on MAJOR-1: plan 28.5 claimed inherited eligibility and role-note files not present in the folder and left the practice start state undetermined; MINOR-1..7 wording.
text_review.fixes: 28.5 and top note: files regenerated by the unchanged tools; v1.1 starts from 8 practice settings; the reserve rule runs again; non-moving reserve settings stay final; operator-read v1.0 questions never reused. DeepSeek ceiling 1,260 items. Units per survival row. Missing later pass stops a real run. Status text 'for version 1.1'.
text_review.round_2: ACCEPT, with MINOR-A (unit label of four rows in FILE_FORMATS 11.1) fixed before seal step 1.
text_review.verified: brief equals constants line for line (66 lines); no v1.0 constants key removed; floors 36/20/100/100, reserve targets 45/25, key check and no-passage texts byte-unchanged; section 28 counts match the sealed v1.0 files; custody holds; lowest-pass-first is a fixed rule.

tool_review.reviewer: separate sub-agent (general-purpose), read-only apart from the dry drivers' outputs
tool_review.round_1: REJECT on MAJOR-1: tools/ob_assemble.py still enforced the v1.0 one-candidate-per-pair rule and would stop every v1.1 run with SURVIVAL_COUNT_DOES_NOT_MATCH; MINOR-1 missing later pass skipped in a real run; MINOR-3 curly apostrophes; MINOR-5 replay: OPTIONS_MATCH_EACH_OTHER as first coded fired on 135 of 324 v1.0 role-step questions.
tool_review.operator_decisions: ob_assemble.py brought in line; MISSING_PASS_FILE stop in a real run; OPTIONS_MATCH_EACH_OTHER requires the looser test AND at least 2 shared content words (question_rules.no_two_options_match_min_shared_content_words = 2); passage normalised with plain() before WRONG_OPTION_NOT_FROM_PASSAGE.
tool_review.round_2: ACCEPT (six tools). Dry drivers: fixture_q 49 runs, 114 of 114 checks held; fixture_n 78 runs, 189 of 189 held. Replay on sealed v1.0 practice questions with the final rules, role-step 324 / 48 candidates / 16 survivors: OPTIONS_MATCH_EACH_OTHER 87 / 14 / 4; WRONG_OPTION_NOT_FROM_PASSAGE 67 / 13 / 5; QUESTION_REPEATS_KEY 1 / 0 / 0; any 135 / 21 / 7. Plain-fact 170 / 86 / 44: 9 / 4 / 2.
tool_review.verified: key check and no-passage rule lines byte-identical to v1.0 (ob_solve_blind.py decide); custody unchanged; all hashes match disk.

open_minor_notes: MINOR-4 (tool review): a no-passage solver may see up to three variants of one pair with the same key option; this can only make a question fail the no-passage check (conservative), never leak.
MINOR-6/7 (text review): schema names of candidates and selection files kept at v1; NOT_BELONG may lose most questions at the no-passage check by construction.
verdict: ACCEPT. No BLOCKER and no MAJOR open. Seal step 1 of the v1.1 chain may be written.
